description: WhatsApp/Messenger automation scenarios (Phase 3/6). Re-run on the pilot phone after every WhatsApp/Messenger app update — Tier 2 node matching is the fragile part. Pass = correct chat opened, confirmed text only is sent, failures say so out loud and send nothing.

scenarios.given: Contact 'Maria Silva' with a valid Portuguese mobile number; VLM consent irrelevant
steps: Say: Manda um WhatsApp à Maria a dizer já cheguei
Expect read-back: Quer enviar "já cheguei" por WhatsApp para a Maria Silva?
scenarios.expected: Tier 1 wa.me link opens the Maria Silva chat with the text pre-filled (or message sent via Tier 2); action log gains a WhatsApp entry
scenarios.fail_signal: Wrong chat opened, text sent without confirmation, or silent failure

scenarios.given: Contact 'Maria Silva' WITHOUT a phone number (name-only contact); accessibility ON
steps: Say: Manda um WhatsApp à Maria a dizer olá
scenarios.expected: Tier 2 opens WhatsApp, finds the chat by name, types and sends only the confirmed text
scenarios.fail_signal: Any other chat opened; anything sent when the chat is not found (must fail loudly instead)

steps: Say: Ler as mensagens do WhatsApp
scenarios.expected: App explains, in Portuguese and out loud, that accessibility must be enabled, and offers the settings route via the caregiver

scenarios.given: A chat with 3+ recent incoming messages; accessibility ON
scenarios.expected: Latest messages are shown large and read aloud in Portuguese; no UI chrome ('online', 'escrever uma mensagem') is read
scenarios.fail_signal: Reads the whole contact list, reads UI labels as messages, or reads nothing with no explanation

scenarios.given: Contact 'Ana Pereira' in Messenger; accessibility ON
steps: Say: Manda uma mensagem no Messenger para a Ana a dizer olá
scenarios.expected: Tier 2 opens the Ana Pereira conversation, types 'olá', sends; log entry recorded
scenarios.fail_signal: m.me opens but text is claimed sent when it was not typed (Tier 1 cannot pre-fill Messenger text)

steps: Say: Manda uma mensagem no Messenger para a Ana a dizer olá
scenarios.expected: Messenger opens at the chat (m.me) and the app honestly says it cannot type without accessibility — it must NOT claim the message was sent

scenarios.given: Two contacts: Maria Silva and Maria Santos
scenarios.expected: Disambiguation screen with both Marias, big buttons; nothing dialled until one is tapped and confirmed

scenarios.given: Any send flow at the confirmation step
scenarios.expected: Nothing is sent or dialled; app says 'Está bem, não faço nada.'
scenarios.fail_signal: Message sent / call placed after NÃO
